title: White & Blue Floral Cotton Halter Peplum Top with Palazzo Co-ord Set
description:
A breezy summer co-ord made in Jaipur by Bahe Kurtiz – a soft cotton halter-style peplum top in a white, blue and grey floral print, paired with easy off-white cotton palazzo pants.

The top has a flattering V halter neckline with delicate white lace trim, an open back, a lace-trimmed empire waist and a gathered peplum flare that sits beautifully at the hip. The off-white palazzo is wide-legged, light and airy, with a comfortable elastic waist – perfect for long summer days.

• Top: 100% cotton, floral print, halter V-neck, sleeveless, lace trim, gathered peplum, hip length
• Palazzo: cotton, off-white, wide leg, elastic waist, ankle length
• Light, breathable and easy to wear all day
• Perfect for vacations, brunch, college, casual Fridays and summer evenings
• Style it with flats for a relaxed look or heels for a party look

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
